mapper.select: SELECT id FROM swm_area WHERE area_type = '3' AND status = '0'

SELECT a.id AS "id", a.name AS "name", jso.office_name AS "organization", pa.position_name AS "workshop", pl.prod_line_name AS "process", wg.work_group_name AS "team", hd.device_id AS "deviceId", CASE WHEN hd.device_id IS NULL OR hd.device_id = '' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS "workStatus", CASE WHEN hd.device_id IS NULL OR hd.device_id = '' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS "helmetStatus", a.personnel_status AS "personnelStatus", COALESCE(da_stats.attendance_count, 0) AS "attendanceCount", COALESCE(da_stats.working_hours, 0) AS "workingHours", COALESCE(da_stats.idle_hours, 0) AS "idleHours", a.identity_card AS "idCard", a.create_by AS "creator", a.create_date AS "createTime", a.update_by AS "updater", a.update_date AS "updateTime", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status" FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON a.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line pl ON a.prod_line = pl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON a.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office jso ON a.company = jso.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_helmet_device hd ON a.identity_card = hd.assigned_person AND hd.status = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT da.employee_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN da.clock_in_date IS NOT NULL OR da.clock_out_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS attendance_count, -- 閺堫剚婀€閸戝搫瀚熷▎鈩冩殶 - 鐎圭偤妾崙鍝勫珶濞嗏剝鏆?鐎圭偤妾崙鍝勫珶婢垛晜鏆?閺堫剚婀€閺堝绗傞悵顓熷ⅵ閸楋紕娈戞径鈺傛殶 COALESCE(SUM(da.effective_work_hours), 0) AS working_hours, -- 閺堫剚婀€瀹搞儰缍旈弮鍫曟毐 - 濮ｅ繑妫╃€圭偤妾銉ょ稊閺冨爼鏆? COALESCE(SUM(da.idle_hours), 0) AS idle_hours -- 閺堫剚婀€閹姴浼愰弮鍫曟毐 - 濮ｅ繑妫╅幀鐘蹭紣閺冨爼鏆遍幀璇叉嫲 FROM swm_daily_attendance da WHERE da.status = '0'
AND DATE_FORMAT(da.attendance_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{timeValue}
AND DATE_FORMAT(da.attendance_date, '%Y-%u') = #{timeValue}
AND DATE_FORMAT(da.attendance_date, '%Y-%m') = #{timeValue}
AND DATE_FORMAT(da.attendance_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY da.employee_id ) da_stats ON a.id = da_stats.employee_id
a.status = '0'
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND jso.office_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organization}, '%')
AND pa.position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workshop}, '%')
AND pl.prod_line_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{process}, '%')
AND wg.work_group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{team}, '%')
AND (hd.device_id IS NULL OR hd.device_id = '')
AND hd.device_id IN
#{deviceId}
AND a.personnel_status = #{personnelStatus}
ORDER BY a.create_date DESC
